boost.pendingBody: We've received your request. Once we confirm your payment off-app, we'll activate your boost and you'll appear at the top of search results.
boost.availableBody: Boost your listing to appear at the top of search results with a Featured badge. It's a manual process — send us your request and we'll confirm your payment off-app before activating it.
boost.howBody:
1. Request a boost here.
2. We contact you to arrange payment (bank transfer / Instapay / cash).
3. After confirmation, we activate your featured listing from the console and you'll rank higher in results.
